reuse.why: Fintegra goes through the existing refuseAlreadyLinkedBankAccount wrapper, findOrCreateBank and syncAccount dispatch, and through the new shared linkBankSyncAccount and downloadBankSyncTransactions helpers.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a sixth copy of the link and download code, it collapses the existing per-provider copies into one link helper and one transactions-download helper.

placement.why: Link logic stays in accounts/app.ts, download logic in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config.ts and the account type under types/models, matching the other providers.

scope.why: A server-side addition of one provider rewrites the link and download paths of GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking (with small default changes such as official_name and institution shape), a large refactor outside the request.

maintainability.why: The resulting shared helpers make providers easy to add and maintain, though the size of the unrequested refactor makes the change risky to review in one go.
